# ExploreLearning

> ExploreLearning delivers research-driven K-12 STEM solutions including interactive virtual simulations (Gizmos), adaptive math learning (Reflex, Frax), and science curricula (Science4Us) designed for serious educational impact.

ExploreLearning is a leading provider of digital STEM education tools for K-12 schools, offering evidence-based products that combine virtual labs, adaptive learning technology, and comprehensive curriculum support. The company's solutions are grounded in educational research and designed to improve student outcomes across mathematics and science.
